title: Teleost single circuit (heart -> gills -> body -> heart) for the flying-fish viewer
note: Directed graph. share = fraction of cardiac output on that edge at rest (null = not sourced). object = anatomy-model/manifest.json object name (null -> see position_hint). term_id = id in dashboard/public/blueprint3d/data.json terms (looked up 2026-10-31; null where no term exists; the manifest gills, intestine, swim bladder and muscle objects carry no ontology id). o2: oxygenated | deoxygenated | oxygenating. No flying-fish circulation data were found; all values are other-teleost proxies or assumptions. No bird data used.

venous_PO2_kPa.source: rest: derived (gills.json Pb_in); floor: steffensen1998 8.6 torr at fatigue (trout)

flow_note: flow on an edge (ml/min/kg) = share x cardiac output
